evals.prompt: i ran `pear init ui --yes` and the app shows up but the title bar isn't draggable on mac. how do i fix it?
evals.expected_output: Add `-webkit-app-region: drag` to a parent containing <pear-ctrl>, with no-drag on clickable children.

evals.prompt: i'm migrating from pear v1. my app uses Pear.Window and Pear.tray. what's the v2 equivalent?
evals.expected_output: import ui from 'pear-electron'; use ui.Window, ui.app.tray. Notes Pear.config -> Pear.app, recommends adding pear.pre = pear-electron/pre.

evals.prompt: my pear desktop app needs to call our api at https://api.example.com. when i `fetch()` it errors. why?
evals.expected_output: HTTP/HTTPS blocked by default; add the host to pear.links.

evals.prompt: what's the smallest possible index.js for a v2 pear-electron app?
evals.expected_output: 5-7 line snippet: import Runtime from 'pear-electron', import Bridge from 'pear-bridge', bridge.ready, runtime.start({bridge}), pipe.on('close', Pear.exit).

evals.prompt: i want my pear desktop app to live-reload on file changes
evals.expected_output: Pear.updates(() => Pear.reload()) for bundle-level reload, or pear-hotmods for HMR.

assertions.value: Recommends `Pear.updates(() => Pear.reload())` or `pear-hotmods`, not a third-party file watcher.
